name: Inaho Shin
source:
A father of three daughters and a devoted husband. His own store, YuKuRu, has been closed for an extended period due to an accident involving a car crashing into it. He is currently called back to his former workplace, Ressac, where he is working as a temporary trainer at the Fujikawa store. He is well-known in the local community, with many long-time acquaintances including [url=/c137847]Minami Tsubame[/url].
[translated from digital setting materials]
